events.title: The Islamic calendar begins its first year
events.description: The first day of the year of the Hijra, 1 Muharram AH 1, corresponds to 16 July 622. Caliph Umar later chose the year of Muhammad's migration from Mecca to Medina as the starting point of the Islamic era.
events.html: The first day of the year of the Hijra, 1 Muharram AH 1, corresponds to 16 July 622. Caliph Umar later chose the year of Muhammad's migration from Mecca to Medina as the starting point of the Islamic era.

events.title: Christian kings defeat the Almohads at Las Navas de Tolosa
events.description: The kings of Castile, Aragon and Navarre routed the Almohad caliph's army in the Sierra Morena. The battle broke Almohad power in Iberia and opened Andalusia to Christian conquest.
events.html: The kings of Castile, Aragon and Navarre routed the Almohad caliph's army in the Sierra Morena. The battle broke Almohad power in Iberia and opened Andalusia to Christian conquest.

events.title: Stockholms Banco issues Europe's first banknotes
events.description: Sweden's Stockholms Banco began issuing paper credit notes, the first banknotes in Europe. The bank over-issued and collapsed within a few years, but paper money was here to stay.
events.html: Sweden's Stockholms Banco began issuing paper credit notes, the first banknotes in Europe. The bank over-issued and collapsed within a few years, but paper money was here to stay.

events.title: The first atomic bomb is detonated in New Mexico
events.description: The Trinity test at 5.29 am in the Jornada del Muerto desert proved the plutonium bomb worked. Oppenheimer later recalled the Bhagavad Gita: 'Now I am become Death, the destroyer of worlds.'
events.html: The Trinity test at 5.29 am in the Jornada del Muerto desert proved the plutonium bomb worked. Oppenheimer later recalled the Bhagavad Gita: 'Now I am become Death, the destroyer of worlds.'

events.title: Apollo 11 launches for the Moon
events.description: A Saturn V rocket lifted Neil Armstrong, Buzz Aldrin and Michael Collins from Kennedy Space Center. Four days later Armstrong and Aldrin became the first people to land on the Moon.
events.html: A Saturn V rocket lifted Neil Armstrong, Buzz Aldrin and Michael Collins from Kennedy Space Center. Four days later Armstrong and Aldrin became the first people to land on the Moon.

events.title: Fragments of Comet Shoemaker-Levy 9 begin hitting Jupiter
events.description: Over six days some 21 fragments of the comet slammed into Jupiter, the first collision between solar system bodies ever observed. They left dark scars in the atmosphere larger than Earth.
events.html: Over six days some 21 fragments of the comet slammed into Jupiter, the first collision between solar system bodies ever observed. They left dark scars in the atmosphere larger than Earth.
